title: New lower bounds for Ramsey numbers R(K_k - e, K_l - e) and R(K_k - e, K_l)
description: Explicit graphs, with exact checkers, improving lower bounds in Table IIIa of Radziszowski's dynamic survey Small Ramsey Numbers (DS1.18, April 2026). Each graph extends Van Overberghe's 64-vertex (K5-e, K7-e)-graph by vertices found with an exact SAT search. The release contains the graphs (graph6 and adjacency matrix), SHA-256 hashes, the exact difference from the base graph, three independent checkers and their outputs.
